_comment: Golden metric-row vectors. ONE dataset judged by both sides of the historisation boundary: colca-historian (Go) decides which column a measurement lands in, and the api's MetricSerializer reads that column back out. They are separate implementations in separate languages, so the mapping between a _Metric value and its storage column is exactly the kind of fact that drifts silently — a value written to value_number and read from value_text simply disappears from a chart. The cases RESTATE shipped behaviour (colca/internal/historian/record.go, api/src/historian/models/metric.py); changing one is a storage-format change and needs both suites green.

cases.why: a string parameter keeps its text column
a status flag is boolean, never the number 1
an array is a structure too
beyond float64 precision the digits are kept verbatim rather than rounded into value_number

not_measurements.why: a tombstone deletes the retained value; it is not a reading
a null value has no column to land in

refused.why: without a signal the row is unattributable and nothing downstream can repair it
